title: Hold a licence to handle explosives where required
what: Store, handle or transport dangerous goods, including explosives, only under a licence where the regulations require one.

sources.title: Dangerous Goods Safety Act 2004 (WA)
sources.quote: A person who engages in an activity relating to the storage, handling or transport of dangerous goods, other than an activity to which section 12, 13 or 15 applies, commits an offence if — (a) the regulations require the person to hold a licence to engage in the activity; and (b) the person does not hold a licence under the regulations

reach.condition: if it handles explosives or explosive precursors (such as for blasting, manufacture, storage or sale)
